authorship: Project-authored chest-region stage illustrations based on the cited textbook narrative; not measured patient data or validated disease presets

stages.HyperacuteInjury: reference projected QRS scaled 125%, width 120%; fused J250/peak800uV at 60% of J-to-QT
stages.AcuteMonophasic: QS; fused J500/peak650uV at 65% of J-to-QT
stages.AcuteQInvertedT: Q with reduced R; J200/ST-end100uV; T -500uV
stages.SubacuteDeepT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T -500uV
stages.SubacuteRecoveringT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T -200uV
stages.OldQNormalT: Q with reduced R; ST0; reference projected T
stages.OldQInvertedT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T -150uV
stages.OldQLowT: Q with reduced R; ST0; T50uV

limitations: Manual snapshots, no automatic time course, treatment response or Q disappearance model. Q width follows selected QRS duration and is not classified by a detector. Custom chest selection retains unselected leads; named limb territories have algebraically coupled changes, not a validated reciprocal disease model. Preserve P/U; optional regional repolarization extension changes QT explicitly. Stage values override selected ST/T/QRS controls.

territories.Inferior: II/III/aVF; drive II by zero-sum RA/LA/LL [-u,-u,2u]
territories.Lateral: I/aVL/V5/V6; drive I by zero-sum RA/LA/LL [-u,2u,-u]
territories.implementation: u is a ties-even Q32 third of desired lead change; duplicate the positive u band twice to retain exact zero-sum after interpolation. Related limb leads change algebraically; unchanged Wilson preserves nonselected chest leads.
territories.not_available: V7-V9 posterior and V3R-V4R right ventricular leads not in the current twelve-lead topology. No culprit-vessel inference.

repolarization_delay: Optional explicit nonnegative regional extension: QT and T duration increase equally, preserving ordinary T onset and ST duration. Fusion keeps J and extends its J-to-QT span. Active region required; zero preserves prior samples. Validate cycle capacity and reject extension beyond existing nonzero U onset; never move U implicitly.
independent_components: Optional explicit QRS Reference/QWithReducedR/QS, nullable T peak (null=reference, zero=suppressed), and independent J/ST-end/arch potentials. Components override stage targets, including stage None, in one chosen region. Regional delay remains separate. No tissue-contribution ablation, severity rule or automatic Q qualification.
